dct_description_sm:
Author: Policy Planning, PDBS

Author email: OP@ottawa.ca

Maintainer Organization: Geospatial Analytics, Technology and Solutions (GATS), PDBS

Update frequency: As required by Official Plan Amendment and Council approval

Accuracy: Not intended to represent exact location on the ground

Attributes:

  • TRANSECT_EN alias: English Transect (English Transect Name i.e. Downtown Core, Inner Urban, Outer Urban, Suburban, Greenbelt, Rural)
  • TRANSECT_FR alias: French Transect (French Transect Name i.e. Centre-ville, Urbain intérieur, Urbain extérieur, Suburbain, Rural)
  • DESIGN_EN alias: English Designation (English Official Plan Designation i.e. Transect Policy Areas)
  • DESIGN_FR alias: French Designation (French Official Plan Designation i.e. Secteurs stratégiques du transect)

Download Formats: Shapefile, GeoJSON, CSV, KML
